summary: Module 7 BREAK: critique of the fictional 'Database Outage' postmortem. Every problem, enumerated: (1) Blame-focused: 'John ran the migration', 'John deployed... without testing', 'John needs to be more careful' -- individuals named as subjects throughout, violating blamelessness. (2) Vague timeline: 'Friday afternoon', 'Friday evening', 'Saturday morning' -- no precise timestamps (the module demands '14:23 UTC', not 'around midday'); also no event granularity (migration start, first error, mitigation, rollback, restore). (3) Root cause is a symptom statement: 'dropped an index... causing all queries to timeout' describes the trigger, not WHY the system allowed it -- no contributing factors about the missing test gate, missing PR review requirement, missing migration dry-run, or absence of automated migration checks. (4) Contributing factors are people/events, not system gaps: 'John did not test', 'team was in a rush', 'nobody reviewed' -- these imply 'hire more careful people', not 'fix the pipeline'. (5) Impact is vague and unmeasured: 'Some users could not log in for a while' -- no count of affected users, duration, error rate, or revenue/SLA impact. (6) Remediations are non-executable and/or human-directed: 'Developers should test migrations' (no mechanism, no checkable gate), 'John will have PRs reviewed' (names a person, not a process), 'Try to avoid deploying on Fridays' (superstition, not engineering; and unowned 'Everyone'). None change the system. (7) 'John's manager' as owner is blame-by-ownership. (8) Lessons learned are circular: 'John needs to be more careful' and 'We should not deploy on Fridays' restate the incident without extracting a class-level lesson. (9) Missing: no PITR/backup verification step, no monitoring alert description, no success criteria for remediation, no severity classification, no customer communication record. Corrected versions: CF1 'The migration pipeline did not require a schema-diff dry-run or automated migration test on staging before production'; CF2 'The PR review requirement was not enforced by a required-reviewer gate'; R1 'Add a CI migration-test job that runs prisma migrate deploy / alembic upgrade head against a disposable staging DB and asserts schema integrity before merge'; R2 'Enforce required reviewers via branch protection'; R3 'Add an index-liveness check to readiness probes'.
evidence: Full anti-pattern inventory: blame subjects, vague timeline, symptom-only root cause, person-based factors, unmeasured impact, non-executable remediations, circular lessons
Corrected system-language versions for CFs and R1-R3
S3 standard applied: every fix must change structure, not ask humans to be better
